assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and exertional dyspnea, raising concern for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation in the setting of known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency.
A cardiac event monitor is ordered to capture rhythm data during symptomatic episodes to guide further management and assess the burden of arrhythmia.
The service is medically necessary to document the arrhythmia associated with the patient's diagnosed condition.
